description: This file defines models and fetcher classes for retrieving Fama-French factor data, including query parameters, data structures, and data extraction/processing methods.

classes.name: FamaFrenchFactorsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching Fama-French factors, including region, factor, frequency, start and end dates, with validation logic.

classes.name: FamaFrenchFactorsData
classes.description: Data model representing fetched Fama-French factor data, including various factor return fields and date.

classes.name: FamaFrenchFactorsFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class responsible for retrieving and processing Fama-French factor data based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts generic query parameters dictionary into a FamaFrenchFactorsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches factor data from external source based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Processes raw fetched data into structured FamaFrenchFactorsData objects, applying date filters.
